claims.claim: All frozen response rules for q>=3 form the displayed one-real-parameter family; q2 has a unique square-root rule.
HB and the specified distance-three-thinned HB fail channel composition in the frozen neutral clock.
Actual q12/N2 admits an s=1/2 global-clock coincidence; actual q12/N3 cannot match HB for any s even via a common clock depending on the full current state.
Actual LOO conditional fields give Gibbs-reversible count rates with multinomial multiplicity and a bounded-gain CN cap, not a universal unit attempt clock.
Uniform linear response and parity-line scalar drift are independent of s; no all-s path limit is asserted.
